title: SAP selector regeneration
when_to_use: When SAP GUI selector breaks after a patch
prompt_text: Given this broken selector and the surrounding XAML, suggest a relaxed selector using role-based attributes that survives the next SAP patch.

title: AD portal relaxed xpath
when_to_use: When AD portal control ids change
prompt_text: Given the portal HTML dump, produce a webctrl selector that tolerates id renames using aaname and stable attributes only.

title: DU classifier training suggestion
when_to_use: When Document Understanding confidence drops below 0.7
prompt_text: Given the misclassified document and the current classifier's labels, suggest the smallest training sample that fixes this class without regressing others.

title: Retry-interval tuning
when_to_use: When retry loops exhaust during month-end or peak load
prompt_text: Given the RetryScope config and the exception pattern, suggest a calendar-driven retry interval that stays within SLA.
